common_name: Afrotropical Savanna Fruit Fly (Abdominal Yellow/Tan Melanic Gradation)

phenomenon_scale.anatomical_structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Drosophila yakuba (2.2 µm, detail scale)

paleobiology.predecessor_note: Willistoni is the chronoseries predecessor at the cellular pigment-band tier (86 µm). This slot descends to the 2.157 µm subcellular granule/ocellus wavelength. No successor (terminus 41/41).

governing_model.steady_state: u0 = a + b, v0 = b / u0²
governing_model.critical_wavenumber: k_c² = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)
governing_model.boundary_conditions: periodic on a rectangular patch of abdominal tergite cuticle; no-flux is the biological ideal, periodic is the discrete Fourier test domain

parameters.note: Distinct from slot 2731 (97 µm cellular yakuba: alpha_scale 1.48, beta_offset 0.252, y ~ x^1.25). D_v/D_u = 20 places the fastest-growing Schnakenberg mode at λ* = 2.157 µm on this patch.

state_variables.v: Ebony/NBAD substrate (fast, depletes the melanin precursor)

empirical_claims: Carbone et al. 2005: pigmentation difference between D. yakuba and D. santomea is polygenic (QTL).
Wittkopp et al. 2002: Yellow and Ebony have reciprocal effects on melanin versus NBAD sclerotin.
Turing 1952 / Schnakenberg 1979: a homogeneous steady state stable without diffusion can be unstable at a finite wavenumber when the inhibitor diffuses faster than the activator.
This reconstruction pins the selected wavelength of that instability to 2.157 µm (2.2 µm detail tier) and does not claim the QTL papers measured a 2.2 µm granule spacing.
